verdict.rationale: Brevo documents first-party natural-language operation: you can manage campaigns and contacts from ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools via its Model Context Protocol integration, and its built-in Aura AI answers plain-language questions about your data. The claims are brief marketing and docs statements, with no detail on which actions can be driven by natural language. Missing for 10: documented scope of natural-language-controllable operations beyond campaigns and contacts, in-depth setup docs for the AI integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Integrate Brevo with AI assistants using the Model Context Protocol. Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Ask plain‑language questions and get instant answers from your data with Aura AI.
